programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park exigent un vaccin contre la COVID-19. Des militants refusent que M. Garrison se fasse vacciner. Randy reconnaît qu'il a joué un rôle dans la propagation de l'épidémie. Cartman n'est pas ravi de retourner à l'école."

programme.title: South Park: Cartman a une sonde anale
programme.desc: Les aliens implantent un émetteur dans Cartman et kidnappent le frère de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Muscle Plus 4000
programme.desc: Cartman tente de se muscler en prenant du Muscle Plus 4000. De son côté, Mr Garrison essaye d'assassiner Kathie Lee Gifford.

programme.title: South Park: Volcan
programme.desc: Les enfants partent à la chasse avec Jimbo, l'oncle de Stan, lorsqu'un volcan entre en éruption. Cartman invente la légende de Kucrapok pour faire peur aux autres mais est-ce seulement imaginaire ?

programme.title: South Park: Un éléphant fait l'amour avec un cochon
programme.desc: Les enfants cherchent à faire un croisement entre un éléphant et un cochon de lait.
programme.sub-title: Un éléphant fait l'amour avec un cochon

programme.title: South Park: La Mort
programme.desc: Marvin Marsh, le grand-père de Stan, veut absolument mourir. Il demande à son petit-fils de l'aider.

programme.title: South Park: Conjonctivite Aiguë
programme.desc: Kenny meurt. À la morgue, les croque-morts se servent d'une sauce comme liquide d'embaumement.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Damien, le fils de Satan arrive à South Park où son père et Jesus s'apprêtent à livrer bataille.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petit Etherniopien
programme.desc: Pensant recevoir une montre à quartz, les enfants envoient cinq dollars en Éthiopie mais ils reçoivent en fait un enfant du pays.

programme.title: South Park: Monsieur Hankey, le petit caca Noël
programme.desc: Noël approche et les enfants préparent un spectacle sur la naissance de Jésus. Mais voilà qui ne plait pas aux parents de Kyle, dont la famille est juive.
programme.sub-title: Monsieur Hankey, le petit caca Noël

programme.title: South Park: Chirurgie Esthétique
programme.desc: M. Garrison doit subir une rhinoplastie et se fait remplacer par la sulfureuse Mlle Ellen.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Barbara Streisand cherche à former le diamant de Panthéos pour revêtir sa forme ultime, Mecha Streisand, et détruire South Park.

programme.title: South Park: La mère de Cartman est une folle du cul
programme.desc: Cartman ignore qui est son père. Alphonse Mephisto veut bien l'aider mais les recherches coûtent 3000 $.
programme.sub-title: La mère de Cartman est une folle du cul

programme.title: South Park: La mère de Cartman est toujours une folle du cul
programme.desc: Le suspense est à son comble, Mephisto va dévoiler qui est le père de Cartman, lorsque soudain on lui tire dessus.
programme.sub-title: La mère de Cartman est toujours une folle du cul

programme.title: South Park: Le Charmeur de poules
programme.desc: Le bibliobus arrive à South Park. Les enfants n'en ont cure, jusqu'à ce qu'une affaire de viol de poules n'éclate.

programme.title: South Park: Le Zizi de Ike
programme.desc: Kyle apprend que ses parents veulent faire circoncire son frère. Pendant ce temps, M. Mackey découvre la drogue.

programme.title: South Park: Le Foetus Siamo Maxiliaire
programme.desc: Les citoyens de South Park viennent en aide à l'infirmière de l'école, qui a une étrange dégénérescence médicale.

programme.title: South Park: La grenouille mexicaine hypnotique du sud du Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Jimbo et Ned animent une émission sur la chasse sur une chaîne du câble.
programme.sub-title: La grenouille mexicaine hypnotique du sud du Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: La Ville au bord de l'Eternité
programme.desc: Le bus scolaire est coincé face à une falaise. Mlle Crabtree va chercher de l'aide et devient alors une vedette.
programme.sub-title: La Ville au bord de l'Eternité

programme.title: South Park: L'Eté, Ca Craint
programme.desc: Alors que Jimbo et Ned veulent faire des feux d'artifice pour le 4 juillet, M. Garrison s'aperçoit que M. Toc a disparu et qu'il est 'son côté gay'.

programme.title: South Park: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé
programme.desc: Le festival de Sundance arrive à South Park. Mais les festivaliers étouffent M. Hankey avec leurs déjections pleines de nourriture bio.
programme.sub-title: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé

programme.title: South Park: La Varicelle
programme.desc: Les parents de South Park décident de donner la varicelle à leurs enfants pour éviter qu'ils ne l'attrapent vieux.

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras
programme.desc: La classe de Mr. Garrison est emmenée au planétarium de South Park, qui est un lieu des plus ennuyeux.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras

programme.title: South Park: La Garçonnière
programme.desc: Alors que Stan doit construire une garçonnière pour jouer à 'action ou vérité' avec Wendy, ses parents se séparent.

programme.title: South Park: Les Journées Vaches
programme.desc: C'est la fête de la vache à South Park. La programmation inclut rodéo et fête foraine.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef a été spolié: on lui a volé des droits sur ses chansons.

programme.title: South Park: Poisson Sanglant
programme.desc: Tante Flo, la sœur de Sharon Marsh, offre à son neveu un poisson rouge. Mais Stan découvre que c'est en réalité un serial killer.

programme.title: South Park: Joyeux Noël Charlie Manson
programme.desc: Kyle, Kenny et Cartman s'en vont pour les fêtes de Noël dans le Nebraska pour aller rendre visite à la grand-mère de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomes
programme.desc: Mr. Tweek risque de perdre son café à cause de la concurrence des cafés Harbucks.

programme.title: South Park: Tropicale, Schtropicale
programme.desc: Les garçons sont envoyés dans la forêt tropicale du Costa Rica avec les enfants de la chorale.

programme.title: South Park: Combustion Spontanée
programme.desc: Les citoyens de South Park prennent feu sans explication. Trouvera-t-on la cause de ces combustions spontanées?

programme.title: South Park: La Maman de Chef
programme.desc: Depuis que Chef a rencontré la fille de ses rêves, les garçons se sentent delaissés.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek contre Craig
programme.desc: Les garçons forcent leurs réticents camarades de classe, Tweek et Craig à se battre.

programme.title: South Park: Les Jakovasaures
programme.desc: Cartman découvre un Jakovasaure femelle, puis un mâle.

programme.title: South Park: Le Panda du Harcèlement Sexuel
programme.desc: Un panda, venu dans la classe de Stan et de ses amis expliquer le principe du harcèlement sexuel et encourager sa dénonciation, déclenche une folie du procès à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Orgie de Chat
programme.desc: Mme Cartman va à la fête donnée chez M. Mackey et laisse son fils sous la garde de Shelly Marsh.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Operation SOP is underway and nearing its final stage! But Trebol proves a far stronger guard for Sugar than was expected, so Robin hatches a plan to lure him away. But is there enough time to execute the plan before the ruse is discovered?
programme.sub-title: Defeat Sugar! The Army of the Little People Charges!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol's furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier's stunning true identity! The Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!
programme.sub-title: The Last Light of Hope! The Secret of Our Commander!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!
programme.sub-title: The Rupture Human! Gladius Blows Up Big Time!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol?
programme.sub-title: A Liar! Usoland on the Run!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp runs into trouble in his battle with Treebol, and flashback sheds light on how a young Kyros made the shocking transition from murderer to one of King Riku's most trusted men.
programme.sub-title: A Fateful Encounter! Kyros and King Riku!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo's chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy.
programme.sub-title: The Operation Failed! Usoland the Hero Dies?!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Toys all across Dressrosa regain their human form, a flood of forgotten memories return, and Kyros launches a long overdue attack on the villainous tyrant Doflamingo!
programme.sub-title: The Legend is Back! Kyros' All-out Blow!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo's clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring!
programme.sub-title: The Fire Fist Strikes! The Flare-Flare Fruit Power Returns!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his newfound followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo's defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos.
programme.sub-title: Dashing onto the Scene! The Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army - Sabo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The mystery of Doflamingo's return from the dead is revealed! But there isn't much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: The Devil's Trap! A Dressrosa Extermination Plan!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game.
programme.sub-title: The 500 Million Berry Man! Target: Usoland!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Doflamingo and Fujitora's agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace, Fujitora stands in his way!
programme.sub-title: Breaking through Enemy Lines! Luffy and Zoro Launch the Counter-Attack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin, Usopp, the Tontattas and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo's deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin'emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town.
programme.sub-title: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Luffy & the others recovering from Pica's attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out.
programme.sub-title: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica's giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action.
programme.sub-title: Steady Progress! Luffy’s Army vs. Pica!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law's handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him.
programme.sub-title: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo's refuge, making his way through Doflamingo's guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit!
programme.sub-title: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas.
programme.sub-title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum.
programme.sub-title: A Great Escape! Luffy's Tide-turning Elephant Gun!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other's necks towards a unified plan.
programme.sub-title: A United Front! Luffy's Breakthrough to the Victory!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hidden far underground, Kin'emon finds his old friend Kanjuro whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along.
programme.sub-title: The Second Samurai! Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.
programme.sub-title: A Hard-Fought Battle Against Pica! Zoro's Deadly Attack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky.
programme.sub-title: The Little People's Princess! Captive Mansherry!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius' exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below.
programme.sub-title: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process?
programme.sub-title: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo.
programme.sub-title: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp uses Viola's Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster, and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp's ammunition has been specially designed for this situation!
programme.sub-title: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy's own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…
programme.sub-title: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Fujitora's stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!
programme.sub-title: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law's traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!
programme.sub-title: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law's attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he's accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon's mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law's life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!
programme.sub-title: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon's actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.
programme.sub-title: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Corazon's double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.
programme.sub-title: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are at an amusement park where they have a special wishing machine. Boots makes a wish: "I wish that when I say, 'bananas,' I get bananas." With a "boing," a bunch of bananas falls down on Boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the Moon before the Sun rises!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Birthday, Super Babies!: It's the Twins' 1st birthday and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a Cake-snatching Bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots find a lovable little space creature named Winky. He came to visit with his family, our Purple Planet friends. But, uh oh, he's lost. We have to get Baby Winky back to his family before their spaceship takes off!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Grumpy Old Troll's getting married to Petunia and we all get to be a part of this wedding! Everything's almost ready, except the Grumpy Old Troll forgot to pick up the rings from his Grandma's House! Will we make it in time for the wedding?!
programme.sub-title: The Grumpy Old Troll Gets Married

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are going on vacation with Diego and Baby Jaguar at the Rainforest Campground. They're packing everything they need, especially Baby Jaguar's favorite, the Dora Snacks!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken's doing magic tricks for us today! For his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken! But when he's going to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that sends the wand flying off into Magic Land where it breaks!
programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Wand

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.sub-title: My Daughter Believes She's Pregnant With Jesus: What Will The Ultrasound Show Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Test Results Revealed: Is 15-Year-Old Marie Really Pregnant Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? The Polygraph Results Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Brittany who says dad Charlie is being scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie hopes to get married when they meet in person. The real women in the photos are on stage & Charlie goes face-to-face!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with a family ripped apart by accusations of child molestation. Father Jason agrees to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Tune in to find out the results and what's next for this family!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
